baseline: adbdafe4 plus PR #426 Java-side changes; production Rust unchanged before winner selection

boundary.stock: Generated production operator in Java on prebuilt BinaryRowData
boundary.native: Instant timer inside Rust, prepared native Arrow buffers, production update/flush/filter and all output fields consumed in Rust
boundary.excluded: Input preparation/import, planning/setup, initial/final JNI/C Data, output parity-file serialization and perimeter transposes
boundary.included: State/accounting, grouping, aggregate updates, filtering, output allocation and checksum consumption/destruction
boundary.warm_prefix: Same first native batch/RowData prefix processed before each timer; retained equally in window state
boundary.consumer: Same logical checksum, full first-warmup value+RowKind multiset oracle; later fixed-schema Java consumer cross-checks every trial against full-value warmup hash/count
boundary.attached: Earlier Java attached-window results remain separate wrapper diagnostics; no Rust-only attached measurement claimed
boundary.caveats: Standalone Rust and Java run in separate processes; all warmups, favorable/unfavorable trials and generic/fixed consumers retained. No complete-job speedup inferred.
